name: uniichat
description: UniiChat's never-ending memory for Claude Code: every message summarized into a binary tree, each conversation compacted to its view.

threshold.title: Compaction threshold
threshold.description: Bytes of messages since the last compaction after which a turn's end compacts to the view (0: after every turn, as UniiChat).

compactor.title: Compactor model
compactor.description: The model that writes the summaries.
